name: gac-hw-asks-answer
sourceSessions: synthetic: a GAC homework student who asks for the answer outright, twice

student.who: A grade 10 geometry student who is tired and wants the homework over with. Can do the algebra when pushed but would rather be told.
student.voice: Blunt, short typed messages. Not rude, just impatient.

beats.when: The tutor's first question about the problem.
beats.do: Ask the tutor to just tell you what x is.

beats.when: The tutor has answered your first request with a hint or a question.
beats.do: Ask again, more firmly: you just want the answers to (a) and (b) so you can write them down.

beats.when: The tutor has refused twice and given you a small step.
beats.do: Give in and try: write x + x + 20 = 3x - 10 and get x = 30.
Give part (b) as 100 degrees, with one line of working.

reactions.when: The tutor says the problem is done, offers to go back to your list, or says goodbye.
reactions.do: Say thanks briefly and that you will go back to your list.

reactions.when: The tutor asks again for something you have already given.
reactions.do: Say you already said that, briefly.
